sn23.8:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
sn23.8:1.6: yato kho rādha, bhikkhu imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamaṃ ca assādaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti,
sn23.8:1.7: ayaṃ vuccati rādha, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā
